meta.title: ENG-889
meta.body_summary: Offload dataset serialization to a FastAPI threadpool to avoid blocking the async event loop, and update the admin UI to use `minimal=true` query to avoid fetching full dataset contents, reducing latency for large datasets.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor offloaded dataset serialization to threadpool and frontend to use minimal=true; maintainer approved and added cypress tests, no quantitative perf evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 826 changed lines across 25 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, though much of it is test fixtures and merge from main. It fits a moderate incremental performance PR that merged with manual testing and cypress validation.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer adamsachs noted that the system information form still uses the non-minimal endpoint and requested updating it to minimal, but this did not block merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Offloading dataset serialization to a threadpool prevents blocking the async event loop; using minimal=true avoids fetching full dataset contents, reducing latency and data transfer for UI.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Offloading blocking operations to a threadpool and adjusting API query parameters are low-level but within Agent capability when the codebase conventions are clear; merge required manual testing and cypress test adjustments.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer adamsachs reviewed the frontend code and identified remaining non-minimal endpoint usage.
detection_detail.manual_test: Maintainer lucanovera tested manually and added cypress tests to cover the changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after benchmarks; manual testing screenshots and cypress tests confirm functional correctness, not speedup.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Cypress tests were fixed and extended to cover the minimal dataset queries; no performance regressions noted.

core_change_summary.description: In generic_overrides.py, the synchronous dataset serialization is run via run_in_threadpool to avoid blocking the async event loop. In the admin UI, dataset queries now include minimal=true to fetch only basic fields, with related test updates.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn from testing fixtures and merge from main; core performance change is in generic_overrides.py (~20 lines) and frontend query additions.
